findings.title: Null guard only covers getSubGroupsCount; subgroup stream methods still NPE on concurrent deletion
findings.body: The PR only null-checks the delegate in getSubGroupsCount. The overloads at lines 256, 262 and 268 still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` directly. `modelSupplier.get()` returns null when the cached group's database row has been deleted concurrently, so these methods throw an NPE exactly like the original getSubGroupsCount bug. A request that filters or paginates subgroups of a group deleted by another request can still fail with a 500. Apply the same null handling, or return a controlled not-found result, consistently across these methods.

findings.title: Regression test does not request subgroup counts, so it may not exercise getSubGroupsCount
findings.body: The new test's reader thread calls `groups(null, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, true)`. The fourth argument is the brief-representation flag; it does not request subgroup counts. Subgroup counts are only populated through `populateSubGroupCount` -> `GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount()` when the subGroupsCount option is enabled. The test would therefore likely pass even with the old NPE and does not guard the changed method. It should request sub-group counts and ideally assert the returned count so it covers the fixed path.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined or stopped on failure, allowing test hang or false pass
findings.body: The test starts a non-daemon thread at line 139 and only sets deletedAll after all deletes. There is no try/finally around the deletes and no join after line 155. If any delete throws, the thread loops forever and can hang the test JVM; even on success the assertion at line 157 runs while the reader may still be in flight, so an exception can be added after the assertion and be silently missed, and the thread can keep using the realm after teardown. Use try/finally to stop the loop and join the thread, and coordinate the first read (for example with a latch) so the race is actually exercised.
